summary: UserPromptSubmit recall hook for Claude Code: shells out to `kb search --hook --max 3`, delivers any pending capture FIRST, and injects a pointer page (title + gist + path) as additionalContext. ADDED 2026-07-30 (PR #114): per-session dedup. Ids already shown are read from os.tmpdir()/coldstart-recall-seen-<session_id>.json (NOT literal /tmp — that path is reserved for the find_nudge state file the nudge handler also reads) and passed as `--seen`; ids are harvested back out of the RENDERED page by matching `→ open: …/notes/<id>.md`, so the hook needs no structured output. The set is cleared on COMPACTION rather than on a clock: the stored transcript byte size is compared against input.transcript_path on each call and a shrink means the context is gone, so previously-shown notes become injectable again (verified E2E: inject -> silent -> shrink -> inject -> silent). All of it is fail-open — any throw leaves dedup off rather than blocking recall. GAP OBSERVED THIS SESSION: hooks/cursor-kb-recall.mjs and hooks/codex-kb-recall.mjs share recallQuery but have NO dedup (grep for --seen returns 0 in both), so this behaviour is Claude-only today.
